note: EU crowdfunding service provider (CSP) authorization under Regulation (EU) 2020/1503 (ECSPR) for lending- and investment-based platforms. Constants across all EU member states: own funds = higher of EUR 25,000 or 1/4 of prior-year fixed overheads, satisfiable by own funds OR an EU-covering insurance policy (Art 11); review = 25 working days completeness check + 3 months decision on a complete file (Art 12); offer cap EUR 5,000,000 per project owner per 12 months; passporting via Art 18 notification = EUR 0 fee, 15-calendar-day clock. service_model: direct = Consulting24 prepares and files; advise-and-coordinate = we guide you and coordinate vetted local partners; comparison-only = we do NOT provide that licence, covered for comparison. Approval always rests with the regulator; no approval is guaranteed.

regime_constants.own_funds: higher of EUR 25,000 or 1/4 prior-year fixed overheads, or insurance policy covering the EU (Art 11)
regime_constants.statutory_review: 25 working days completeness + 3 months decision on a complete application (Art 12)
regime_constants.offer_cap: EUR 5,000,000 per project owner per 12 months
regime_constants.passporting: Art 18 notification, EUR 0, 15 calendar days per member state

jurisdictions.name: Estonia
jurisdictions.our_fee: EUR 37,000 fixed (staged EUR 3,000 + EUR 34,000); optional business plan EUR 3,000
jurisdictions.timeline_practice: ~6-9 months elapsed from company zero to licence
facts: Application filed in Estonian via the Finantsinspektsioon portal (mandatory since 18.03.2026)
Register checked August 2026: 1 active CSP (Estateguru, lending); Crowdestate withdrew its authorization 13.04.2026; no equity/investment-based CSP has ever been licensed in Estonia
Mandatory team: salaried CEO and CFO, AML officer, data protection (compliance) officer; at least one Estonian-resident management board member (local director) is required; IT may be outsourced
0% corporate income tax on retained profits; 22/78 on distributions
Base documentation refined through two completed rounds of Finantsinspektsioon review; approval always rests with the regulator

jurisdictions.name: Lithuania
jurisdictions.state_fee: EUR 710 (paid to the State Tax Inspectorate before filing)
jurisdictions.timeline_practice: ~3-5 months in practice (fastest credible claim in the EU)
facts: 14-15 authorized CSPs, all lending/real-estate models; no equity CSP
Lithuanian crowd-investing market: EUR 278.4M across 500k+ transactions in 2024

jurisdictions.name: Latvia
jurisdictions.state_fee: EUR 2,500 filing + EUR 4,000/year supervision + up to 1.4% of gross revenue (cap EUR 100,000/year)
jurisdictions.timeline_practice: fastest recent Baltic throughput: 4 new CSP licences issued Jul 2025 - Mar 2026
facts: 7 authorized CSPs as of August 2026; one equity platform (CrowdedHero)
Free pre-licensing consultations offered by the regulator

jurisdictions.name: Netherlands
jurisdictions.timeline_practice: varies; total project cost commonly EUR 100,000+
facts: 20 CSPs on the AFM register (register PDF dated 01.06.2026) - the deepest market of the northern EU
Application form available only by emailing the AFM CSP mailbox

jurisdictions.name: Ireland
jurisdictions.state_fee: EUR 0 application fee; Industry Funding Levy applies (first levied on the CSP sector in 2024)
jurisdictions.timeline_practice: among the longer EU processes in practice (exact figure unverified)
facts: Mandatory preliminary meeting; Fitness & Probity Individual Questionnaires for all PCF roles; 'mind and management' substance expected in Ireland
7 CSPs including Republic Europe (formerly Seedrs); the only large English-language ECSPR seat

jurisdictions.name: United Kingdom
jurisdictions.state_fee: GBP 5,640 (P2P, pricing category 5) or GBP 2,820 (arranging/equity, category 4)
facts: No single 'crowdfunding license' - FCA Part 4A permissions by activity; P2P capital: higher of GBP 50,000 or volume-scaled percentage
Restricted Mass Market Investments promotions regime + s21 approver gateway since 7 Feb 2024
A UK authorization gives no EU market access (ECSPR does not apply post-Brexit)
